title: ai features cheat sheet / Customize your workflow
content: ## Customize your workflow | I want to... | Use | |---|---| | Apply project conventions without repeating them | [Instructions](/docs/agent-customization/custom-instructions.md) for coding standards, architecture, and test commands. | | Package a workflow with supporting scripts or examples | [Agent skills](/docs/agent-customization/agent-skills.md), loaded when relevant or invoked by name. | | Run a saved prompt on demand | [Prompt files](/docs/agent-customization/prompt-files.md), invoked as slash commands. | | Define a specialized role and tool selection | [Custom agents](/docs/agent-customization/custom-agents.md), such as a read-only reviewer. | | Connect a database, issue tracker, or other external system | [MCP servers](/docs/agent-customization/mcp-servers.md) that provide tools. | | Run a command at a specific point in the agent's workflow | [Hooks](/docs/agent-customization/hooks.md), rather than relying on the model to follow an instruction. | | Install a packaged set of customizations | [Agent plugins](/docs/agent-customization/agent-plugins.md). | Use the [Agent Customizations editor](/docs/agent-customization/overview.md#agent-customizations-editor) to create and manage these options for your selected harness.
